scientific_integrity: Exact proof uses divisorial valuations and a saturated affine semigroup; finite integer tests corroborate but do not replace the universal proof. The standard rational normal curve relations are attributed as classical.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the explicit complex degree-two foliation family and its specified reduced-model blowups. Does not classify all minimal-volume foliations or the foliated singularities of the Proj model. Historical priority is not independently established.
title: Canonical rings of the geometric-genus-one plane-foliation family
